# Code quality and design · project standards (detail)

## Automated formatting and linting
- **Rule:** ruff formats and lints the code in pre-commit and CI. The tool decides style, not review comments.
- **Why:** Keeps reviews about behaviour, not layout.
- **Status:** Enforced (`.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`).

## Static typing
- **Rule:** Type-annotate all code and run strict mypy in CI.
- **Why:** Catches a whole class of bugs before runtime and documents intent.
- **Status:** Enforced (`[tool.mypy] strict = true`, CI).

## Small, well-named units
- **Rule:** In code you write or change, keep functions short and single-purpose, use domain names, and delete dead code instead of commenting it out.
- **Why:** Small named units are easy to test, review and reuse.
- **Status:** Documented in CLAUDE.md ("Code design"). Deleting dead code is Adopting.

## Simplicity first, abstractions at the planned boundaries
- **Rule:** Build only what the spec needs and choose the simplest design that works. Add interfaces only at the planned protocols (`AnalysisEngine`, `SectionRegenerator`, `LLMClient`). Tolerate a small duplicate until a second real case shows it is the same thing; business rules are never duplicated.
- **Why:** A wrong abstraction costs more than a small duplicate.
- **Decision:** Keep it simple, and apply SOLID only at module boundaries rather than everywhere, because the project is built by one person and is expected to stay small. This matches the existing CLAUDE.md section "Why we don't strictly follow SOLID or DRY".
- **Status:** Documented in CLAUDE.md.

## Explicit error handling
- **Rule:** Never swallow exceptions. Use typed errors, and handle them at the boundaries.
- **Why:** Silent failures are the hardest bugs to find.
- **Status:** Documented in CLAUDE.md ("Fail clearly"). ruff flags bare `except`.

## Dependency injection at boundaries
- **Rule:** Pass external dependencies (LLM client, clock, settings) in. Keep domain logic pure.
- **Why:** Code stays testable without real infrastructure.
- **Status:** Documented in CLAUDE.md ("Pass dependencies in").

## Technical debt register
- **Rule:** Track known debt as GitHub issues labelled `tech-debt`, with their impact.
- **Why:** Visible debt gets managed; invisible debt grows.
- **Status:** Adopting. Claude proposes the issue and the author approves it.

## Comments and docstrings
- **Rule:** Public modules, classes and functions have a PEP 257 docstring. `TODO` and `FIXME` carry a GitHub issue number (`TODO(#n)`). No commented-out code. Comments that a change makes wrong are fixed in the same change.
- **Why:** Code shows what happens; comments and docstrings say why and how to use it.
- **Status:** Comments-explain-why is documented in CLAUDE.md. Docstrings and `TODO(#n)` are Adopting.
